decisions.reason: The GA4 tracking plugin now fits even more tightly with the firm's analytics, shop integration and plugin-development knowledge, so management can readily learn from client use and continue improving it commercially.

The retail system interface plugin remains close to the firm's established customization, interface and shop-operation capabilities, which gives enough absorptive capacity to refine connectors from project experience despite somewhat variable demand.

The shop relaunch SEO support service draws directly on the firm's existing strengths in relaunch projects, search marketing, usability and analytics, making it easy to interpret results and adapt the offer.

SEO workshops build on the firm's marketing and analytics know-how and can benefit from accumulated client experience, but as a more codified training offer outside the core implementation business they face higher uncertainty than the other products.
